reason: I'd try it on a Saturday as a drop-in. $12 for my 4-year-old, the baby is free, and I get a coffee out of it, which beats paying for another indoor place. I wouldn't sign up for the membership, since I can only come on weekends and $74 a month for maybe 4 visits doesn't pay off.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, and I only have Saturdays. Unlimited membership is wasted on me, and if the first visit is crowded or the baby area is too small for a 10-month-old, I won't go back.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend-only or 4-visit pass at around $30 to $35 a month for both kids would get me to join instead of paying drop-in each time.
